title: MeetingConvenedData
description: data of meeting.convened (ADR-0028, a user-requested addition). A person called a lead agent and the agents it supervises into the Meeting Hall of this world, to talk about the run run_id names. actor is that person (a user id), target the lead; district is the lead's district (null for the Director, whom only the owner calls); vis lists every attendee's district. Written by tilo-api through the world's writer after the access checks (MR-01, MR-03); never by a model, never a side effect (authz null). run_state says whether that run was live or had finished; a paused world opens no room. credit_cap and max_turns are this room's caps, from config/meeting_room.yaml and the convener's remaining spend cap at the time.
